subject: Close acceptance windows and signer availability — final paperwork plan
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NimbleRetail MAP: proposed close cadence and paperwork

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our latest mutual action plan (MAP_v6) and a draft SOW that lines up with the evaluation plan your team outlined. To finalize timing for contracting and an activation start date I want to confirm two things from your side:

- Primary signer and their availability window the week of Feb 21–25
- Any internal procurement or legal milestone that would block DocuSign circulation (e.g., vendor intake checklist, PO requirements)

Proposed Redwood acceptance plan (high level):
- Feb 14: Redwood final SOW and pricing lock (we will not change core commercial terms after this)
- Feb 15–18: NimbleRetail internal reviews
- Feb 21–23: DocuSign circulation (signer availability required)
- Mar 1: Target go-live (onboarding kickoff) — contingent on signed SOW + approved onboarding plan

I'm looping Laura (Ops lead) and Rishi (Sales exec) for planning and signature routing. Attachment: Signature_Window_Table.xlsx has our preferred signer windows by role.

Can you confirm who will sign and whether procurement will need a PO prior to signature? If you prefer a single DocuSign envelope, we can combine SOW + standard T&Cs.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego: +1 415-555-0172

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@nimble-retail.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: NimbleRetail Procurement <procurement@nimble-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbleRetail MAP: proposed close cadence and paperwork

Diego —

Thanks for the clear timeline and the updated MAP. Quick answers from our side:

- Primary signer is our VP Product, Dana Liu — she's available Feb 22 (morning) and Feb 23 (afternoon).
- Procurement confirms they need a vendor intake checklist and will issue a PO only after countersigned SOW. They have a standard 3–5 business day lead after SOW countersignature.

Can you:
- Send the final SOW we discussed with the fixed pricing figures by EOD Feb 14
- Prepare a single DocuSign envelope that includes the SOW and our standard mutual NDA (we attach a short procurement checklist separately)

Attaching: NimbleRetail_procurement_checklist.pdf (we will send PO template once legal completes intake).

Alice
Alice Monroe
Head of Partnerships | NimbleRetail
alice.monroe@nimble-retail.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Feb 2027 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: RE: NimbleRetail MAP: proposed close cadence and paperwork

Alice —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the signer availability. Action items from Redwood:

- (Diego) Finalize SOW with fixed pricing and deliver EOD Feb 14 — attaching SOW_NimbleRetail-Draft.docx as the working copy.
- (Laura) Ops will prepare onboarding kickoff schedule contingent on countersign (Laura: please review start date impact if PO arrives on Mar 1).
- (Karthik) Finance: confirm whether any pre-invoice or deposit is required before PO — request your note below.
- (Rishi) Sales: will prepare HubSpot deal record and add signature routing steps to the MAP.

For legal routing: we'll produce a single DocuSign envelope that combines the SOW + Redwood standard T&Cs. Procurement checklist noted — if procurement requires the DocuSign envelope to include a specific PO field, flag it now so we can add a placeholder.

Please confirm Dana's exact email for DocuSign. Once we have Dana and a green PO path, we'll target Feb 22 circulation and Feb 23 finalize.

Best,
Diego

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: NimbleRetail MAP: proposed close cadence and paperwork

Quick internal notes (forwarding for visibility):

- Finance (Karthik): if procurement requires PO before we can start work, confirm whether Redwood can accept a signed SOW + invoicing terms that wait for PO issuance (i.e., kickoff contingent on PO but contract signed). If not, we need to push circulate date later.
- Ops (Laura): please map resource start windows in Signature_Window_Table.xlsx — highlight where 2-week delay would push onboarding.
- Diego: once Dana's email is confirmed, I will request DocuSign routing and set the envelope to require sequential signing (Dana first, then procurement lead).

I'll update the HubSpot deal with the proposed dates and mark this as "signature pending".

-r
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
